title: Research foundation
description: Team formed, problem scoped, precedent research complete.

title: Define the vehicle model
description: Lock mass and inertia budget in SolidWorks; import to Simscape Multibody.

title: Build the simulation environment
description: Stand up PX4 SITL + Gazebo with custom tail-sitter airframe and submersion flag.

title: Characterize the flow
description: First CFD pass for Cd/Cl/Cm sweeps; feed coefficients into Simulink.

title: Prove the propulsion mechanism
description: Bench prototype of dual-mode propulsion, validate thrust against CFD.

title: Move from model to water
description: Hardware-in-the-loop, then pool test of propulsion and waterproofing.
